captions: The order is priced. Now Ines wants tidy shipping labels for the courier.
Names come from the checkout as customers typed them, stray spaces and all.
You tidy the text and write the label, in four small tasks.
Now Maya's label is one tidy line with a city code, and it fits the printer.
Strings and their methods: every label comes out the same way.
